recent_news: Tech Mahindra acquired an 85% stake in Canada-based Avant Techno Solutions for CAD 28 million, a deal expected to close by July 31.

Avant specializes in payments modernization and wealth platforms for North American banks, with capabilities in ISO 20022 migration, wire modernization, real-time rail systems, and core payments cloud transformation.
Avant reported annual revenue of CAD 58.6 million in calendar 2025.
Tech Mahindra plans to acquire the remaining 15% stake by June 30, 2029.
Avant Technologies, Inc. announced a plan to develop a proprietary AI software platform for its data centers, leveraging machine learning for autonomous management.
Avant Technologies is creating a new company to expand its interests in diabetes, potentially through a joint venture, partnership, or acquisition.
additional_context: For a Software Developer role, expect technical interviews focusing on algorithm design, system architecture, software design patterns, performance optimization, and security.
Behavioral questions will assess leadership, teamwork, and problem-solving skills. Use the STAR method for responses.
Key technologies to be familiar with include event-driven systems, CI/CD pipelines, cloud platforms (AWS), PostgreSQL, and Kafka.
The interview process typically starts with an initial phone screen, followed by technical interviews.
Avant Techno Solutions was founded in 2012 and is based in Markham, CA.
Avant's specialties include payments, security, digital transformation, cloud, AI, big data, and blockchain.
